definitions.gloss: outside the vehicle; outside the train or car
definitions.explanation: The space outside a train, car, or other vehicle. The antonym of {車内|しゃない} (inside the vehicle). Common in transit announcements and traffic-safety contexts.

examples.english: to get out of the vehicle

examples.japanese: {危険|きけん}ですので{車外|しゃがい}に{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}さないでください。
examples.english: It is dangerous, so please do not lean out of the vehicle.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{衝撃|しょうげき}で、{乗客|じょうきゃく}が{車外|しゃがい}に{投|な}げ{出|だ}されるおそれがある。
examples.english: The impact of a crash can throw passengers out of the vehicle.

notes:
The antonym of {車内|しゃない} (inside the vehicle). Common in transit announcements and traffic-safety warnings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車外|しゃがい}に{出|で}る: to get out of the vehicle
- {車外|しゃがい}{放出|ほうしゅつ}: being thrown from a vehicle
- {車外|しゃがい}の{景色|けしき}: the scenery outside the vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {車内|しゃない}: inside the vehicle — the direct antonym
